question: How does the speaker identify himself with those known as Bhṛṅgapāda in the world?
premises: They are well known in the world.
The speaker declares himself to be Bhṛṅgapāda.
The goddess is addressed as granter of boons.
inference: The speaker is identical with the world-renowned Bhṛṅgapāda.
uncertainties: The referent of te is not explicitly specified in this verse.
plain_english: O granter of boons, I am also they, well known in the world as Bhṛṅgapāda.
